response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a strong track record across web, mobile, and backend systems, but his profile is overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang ecosystems rather than the modern C++ architecture, IEC 62443 security, IoT/MQTT, and industrial-protocol expertise this role demands. His only substantial C/C++ experience is an 8-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, with no evidence of message brokers, REST/MQTT for IoT, UML/architecture documentation, or industrial cybersecurity standards.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (D-lang, async I/O, fibers, high-throughput microservices)
Strong communication, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing track record (talks, workshops, open source)
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience — last significant C/C++ role was ~2014-2015 at National Instruments
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.), or IoT platform architecture

key_factors.factor: No industrial security/IEC 62443 or IoT protocol experience
Strong general engineering seniority and performance-oriented systems background
